title: 3876. Construct Uniform Parity Array II

examples.explanation: Set nums2[0] = nums1[0] = 1. Set nums2[1] = nums1[1] - nums1[0] = 4 - 1 = 3. Set nums2[2] = nums1[2] = 7. nums2 = [1, 3, 7], and all elements are odd. Thus, the answer is true.
It is not possible to construct nums2 such that all elements have the same parity. Thus, the answer is false.
Set nums2[0] = nums1[0] = 4. Set nums2[1] = nums1[1] = 6. nums2 = [4, 6], and all elements are even. Thus, the answer is true.
